import struct, zlib, pathlib

def chunk(t, d):
    return struct.pack('>I', len(d)) + t + d + struct.pack('>I', zlib.crc32(t+d)&0xffffffff)

# Try a valid PNG with interlace and no IDAT to see if size calc or decode path mishandles.
sig=b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'
ihdr=chunk(b'IHDR', struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',1,1,8,6,0,0,1))
poc=sig+ihdr+chunk(b'IEND', b'')
pathlib.Path('interlace_no_idat.png').write_bytes(poc)
print(len(poc))
